verdict.rationale: Gazebo has its own first-party registry, Gazebo Fuel, which hosts reusable robot and environment models such as PR2, Pioneer2 DX, iRobot Create and TurtleBot (gazebo-gh-5, gazebo-gh-8). Developers can pull from it with a dedicated C++ client library and CLI (gazebo-docs-37), or copy SDF snippets from model pages (gazebo-docs-5). Library packages are also distributed through apt and ROS vendor packages (gazebo-docs-35, gazebo-docs-43). missing for 10: evidence that reusable behavior or controller plugins are shared through a registry (only custom plugin development is documented), detail on Fuel's catalog breadth and versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
